ZEC.summary: NU7 is still set for about Nov 5 (25-second blocks, part of fees set aside), and Grayscale's Zcash ETF keeps taking in money ($41M net over Oct 19-23). A co-founder's proposal to end the 8% dev-fund cut adds governance noise; no vesting unlocks (PoW issuance only).

news.title: Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) takes in $20.5M on Oct 23, the largest altcoin-ETF inflow that day; about $204M net since launch
Co-founder Sean Bowe proposes ending the automatic 8% block-reward cut to Zcash Community Grants; debate over the $125M treasury widens
NU7 roughly 10 days away: Sprout pool to be disabled, operators must run Zebra 7.0.0 before block 3,543,405

MORPHO.summary: Distribution keeps widening, which supports the long: Coinbase now offers fixed-rate BTC-backed loans through Morpho Midnight, and Robinhood opened its USDG Earn (a Morpho vault) to all eligible users. The risk is still the ~973K stolen MORPHO that could be sold; the next unlock (1M to market makers, ~0.15% of circulating) is Nov 20, outside the window.

news.title: Coinbase launches fixed-rate, fixed-term BTC-backed loans powered by Morpho Midnight on Base
Robinhood opens Earn to all eligible users, letting them deposit USDG into a Morpho vault
Mexican exchange Bitso launches Bóvedas, non-custodial USDC and MXNB yield vaults built on Morpho

DOT.summary: DOT closed below $1 (about 13% down on the week) after an XCM bug in dotUSD accounting let arbitrageurs drain about $1.3M from the Treasury's liquidity position; a fix referendum is in voting. CoinShares' Polkadot ETP redemption on Nov 9 is still ahead. No vesting unlocks.

news.title: XCM bug undercounted dotUSD supply; arbitrage cost the Treasury about $1.3M and DOT closed below $1 while a fix referendum is voted
CoinShares to redeem seven Stockholm-listed ETPs including its Polkadot staking product; last trading around Nov 4, redemption Nov 9
Relay chain nearly emptied after the Asset Hub migration; a referendum to rename to JAM fails

LIT.summary: Still supportive for the long: a November CFTC license filing, new options and weETH collateral, and most fees going to LIT buybacks and burns. No unlocks in the next 14 days; the big team/investor cliff is later (late December per Tokenomist research).

news.title: Lighter adds ether.fi's weETH as perp collateral after launching 15-minute BTC/ETH up/down options
Lighter routes almost all of ~$2.8M monthly revenue into LIT buybacks; LIT stalls below $4
Lighter founder says it will apply for US CFTC derivatives licenses in November; LIT up about 23% on the week

AVNT.summary: Avantis has rebranded to Veranta (same AVNT ticker and contract), pitching itself toward RWA and cross-asset leverage; exchanges are just updating display names. No large dated unlock in the next 14 days; DropsTab shows only small ongoing releases (about 0.8M AVNT, roughly 0.2% of circulating supply), which add a little supply for the short.

news.title: Avantis rebrands to Veranta; INDODAX updates the display name, AVNT ticker and contract unchanged

ANIME.summary: No material Animecoin news this week. No dated unlock in the next 14 days; the previously noted Nov 23 release (about 130M ANIME, ~1.3% of supply) falls outside the window.

kBONK.summary: No price-moving BONK news this week beyond chart commentary; it sits around sixth among meme coins by market cap, with BonkBot and BONK.fun fees still funding buybacks and burns. Fully unlocked, so no unlock supply.

WCT.summary: Nothing material this week. Monthly unlocks fall on the 15th; the next (Nov 15) is outside the 14-day window.

BERA.summary: No price-moving BERA news found in the last week. Neither Tokenomist nor DropsTab lists a dated unlock in the next 14 days; only small ongoing linear vesting and validator emissions, which add a little supply.

REZ.summary: No material Renzo news this week. The monthly 80M REZ insider release that was expected around Oct 30 is now dated Oct 28 (already passed) by app.tokenomics.com, with the next around Nov 28, so no confirmed unlock falls in the next 14 days.
